stories.explanation: Acquisition of Swedish Match AB completed in November 2022
stories.signal: Strategic acquisition to strengthen smoke-free portfolio
stories.description: Acquisition de Swedish Match AB en novembre 2022 pour un montant d'environ 2,9 milliards de dollars, permettant à PMI de combiner les marques IQOS et ZYN et de renforcer sa position dans les produits sans combustion
stories._validation: Unit corrected from 'Mds $' to 'B $'. Verified from source: Term loan facility showed '2.5 billion (approximately $2.9 billion)' outstanding for Swedish Match financing. Description enhanced with strategic rationale and brand integration details.
